summary: Implemented default-off NO_TOKEN admission lookahead with receipt-balanced head-prefix pinning, bounded same-head aging, a post-pin capacity reserve, and an unconditional priority-scheduling disable. Later candidates still enter through PrefillAdder.add_one_req, retaining its SWA, Mamba, chunked-prefill, DP-attention, LoRA, request-slot, and prefill-budget gates.

tests.what_was_measured: Expected failing-before result: the recorded base has no lookahead policy and the head NO_TOKEN path stops before later waiting requests.

Ten CPU policy/contract tests plus three subtests: aging, rematch/head-change/removal/admission lock balance, exact reserve boundary, the documented 114752-pin/1792-free/4096-reserve OOM sequence, cache delta sign variants, non-tree rejection, and real RadixCache evictable/protected accounting.
Forty scheduler/admission tests plus fifteen subtests, covering the unchanged PrefillAdder gates alongside the new policy.
Repository formatting, lint, syntax, spelling, and registered-test metadata checks for all changed files.

remaining_limitations: The reported prefill-only H100 TP=8 hierarchical-cache deployment was not available, so the reported throughput, TTFT, idle-round, cache-hit, and production lock-count percentages were not reproduced or claimed.

GPU execution is false: the implementation is scheduler/cache control flow and was validated with CPU contract tests, including the real simulated RadixCache; no model-weight or GPU serving run was used as evidence.
A CPU or single-GPU contract test cannot qualify distributed TP=8 performance or race behavior; deployment-level A/B validation remains required.
No metric counter was added in this first implementation; configuration uses three environment variables and is documented in the pull request.
